unknown_result_policy: Capture all real descendants/results/FAILURE; no deletion or route quarantine; one parent-only fixture queue, default children unchanged
setting_scope: literal global url and explicit uncaptured-native normalization/override Source observations; no general Native admission implied
files_scope: owned synthetic local files only; URL bytes identify rows but no provider fetch
original_authors_credit: Original Dispatcharr/dependency authors retain all code/algorithm/licenses
setting_setup_boundary: Global DB setting before scanner parent; authoritative cached value reapplied before default children. Account custom-properties override applied after actual parent account creation and before children; fixture setup, not task effect.
processes: Actual parent on fixture-only named queue; actual published descendants run on unchanged celery queue. No descendant quarantine.

publication_authority.create_signal: apps/m3u/signals.py refresh_account_on_save: created and non-XC => refresh_m3u_groups.delay; no created signal on repeat
publication_authority.scanner: core/tasks.py scan_and_process_files: processed active file => refresh_single_m3u_account.delay
publication_authority.lineage: both initial direct children inherit actual scanner task root and parent; existing account has Single only; direct synchronous groups fallback inside Single is not a new Celery child
publication_authority.queue_observation: parent is really published while parent worker stopped; full raw parent queue ledger before worker start. Children are really published while default worker stopped; durable raw queue/unacked/backend ledger precedes all assertions. No descendant deletion/quarantine.

ledger_scope: Single owned controller, successful append writes all bytes and fsyncs file; first creation also fsyncs parent directory. Oversized record emits a small fsynced refusal receipt, not full frame evidence. Separate Redis observer reads are racy and qualify only small owned/no-external-writer fixture observations, not strict byte bounds or atomic snapshot.
